name: Light & Dark: Tale of an Assassin
source:
Wilt is a 20 year old game designer in training attending college with his best friends Rhys and Melody. At least during the day, at night he is the Disciple of the Assassin, Aurora.

Thrown into the middle of two sides he struggles with both aspects of life trying to live on the border between. Just staying alive is difficult but now with strange deaths popping up all over, he will be forced to stand on a side. The lives of those he cares for will be tested as will his own beliefs.......

Which road will he take....Light or Dark

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=6714]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
